integrity: The proof uses the support-functional characterization of Birkhoff--James orthogonality to reduce all admissible chords, up to dihedral symmetry, to three explicit triangles. Unit-dual linear certificates prove the global lower bound on each triangle, and an explicit chord attains it. The bundled checker verifies the exact Q(sqrt(3)) identities and facet incidences. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem computes the Joly rectangular constant only for the regular dodecagonal plane. It does not classify all maximizing triples or give an all-regular-polygon formula. The full text of a relevant 2024 generalized-rectangular-constant paper was not publicly available in the checked route.
title: Exact rectangular constant of the regular dodecagonal Banach plane
